description: Cybersecurity protects information and systems from misuse and mistakes. This course teaches everyday defensive habits through fictional school examples and safe local demonstrations. This introductory course uses small examples and short practice tasks. Read the lessons in order, check the result, and try one change. Finishing these lessons gives you a starting point for further study.
versionNote: Introductory examples. Read the setup note before using a separate tool.
whatYouWillLearn: Explain think about the thing you protect
learningObjectives: Practise validate at a trusted boundary

seo.title: Cybersecurity Tutorial for Beginners
seo.description: Learn Cybersecurity Fundamentals with clear steps, small examples and practice questions. Explore the basics at your own pace, then check what you learned.
